title: Joint Research Program on AI and Data Science – ITC & IP Paris
description: A multi-year collaborative research program between ITC and Institut Polytechnique de Paris focused on advancing AI and data science methodologies applicable to Southeast Asian contexts, including healthcare, agriculture, and smart cities.
objective: Develop joint research publications, co-supervised PhD students, and a shared AI research lab (ReDA Lab) accessible to both institutions.

title: ASEAN University Network Data Science Consortium
description: ITC participates in the ASEAN University Network Data Science Consortium, collaborating with universities across Thailand, Vietnam, Malaysia, and Indonesia to harmonize data science curricula and share research resources.
objective: Standardize data science degree programs, enable student exchange, and publish joint research in regional journals.

title: Smart City Technology Partnership – ITC & Smart Axiata
description: A strategic partnership between ITC and Smart Axiata to develop smart city technology prototypes for Phnom Penh, including IoT sensor networks, real-time data dashboards, and AI-powered city services.
objective: Prototype three smart city use cases, provide internship opportunities for 20+ ITC students annually, and file joint patent applications.
